note: Original prompts written for the Creator Program sample pack. These are NOT copied from the production music_descriptions / music_moods catalog. Every artist and every album gets its own prompt so sample content does not collapse into one generic sound.
negative_prompt: no impersonation of real artists, no copyrighted melodies, no uncleared samples, no brand names, no explicit content, no muddy low end, no clipped peaks, no robotic vocal tuning, no generic stock EDM drop
